records.title: Financial advice behaviour: humans versus AI
records.reason: The primary abstract is a financial-advice experiment comparing human advisers and LLMs; it studies advice behavior and portfolio recommendations, not inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: Cornucopia: Elastic GPU Cluster Management for Mixed Batch-Interactive Distributed Training
records.reason: The primary abstract identifies Cornucopia as an elastic GPU cluster manager for interactive and batch distributed training; its objective and measurements are training queue/JCT, outside inference scope.

records.title: NOVA: Noise-to-variation guided pruning of large language models
records.reason: The method is intended to reduce deployment compute/memory, but the primary article does not demonstrate inference/serving efficiency on hardware. The evidence remains too weak for a Research handoff until a sparse-runtime evaluation establishes practical gains.

records.title: Improving modality alignment via multi-scale and selective feature learning in reasoning segmentation
records.reason: The paper addresses modality alignment for reasoning segmentation, a vision segmentation task, with no LLM inference or serving efficiency contribution.

records.title: Causally-motivated generative few-shot reward inference through efficient DPO
records.reason: Primary full text confirms that “efficient DPO” refers to few-shot preference-learning efficiency and DPO training, not LLM inference or serving.
